Nine Dead in Tarapith Hotel Fire; Safety Allegations Surface

A fire at a hotel in Tarapith, Birbhum district, has resulted in the deaths of nine people and the rescue of 28 others. The incident occurred at a hotel where guests were staying. Some guests have alleged that inadequate safety measures and a locked emergency exit contributed to the tragedy. Among the deceased were individuals from Meghalaya and other parts of northern India, some of whom were on a temple trip.
